study_verdict_scope: conditional on changing the worker backend to the codex backend (a BACKEND change, not a config flag inside the default path). The default kilocode path is OPEN and has no closure switch at all.
verdict_note: Nothing dynamic was observed on the default path: the `kilo` binary is not installed on this host, so the default lane cannot be run, let alone probed. `inconclusive` must be treated as not-closed.

observed.evidence: backends built by Loreley's own code: kilo -> ['kilo','run','--auto','--title','t','PROMPT']; codex coding -> ['codex','-a','never','--sandbox','workspace-write','exec','--ephemeral','--color','never','--json']; codex planning -> [... '--sandbox','read-only' ...]; shutil.which('kilo') is None (evidence/04_seam_loreley.log)

mechanisms.why: The backend builds `kilo run --auto` (kilocode_cli.py:716-750) and its dataclass exposes no sandbox, no network and no web-search field (kilocode_cli.py:447-470); `--auto` auto-approves tool use. The lane therefore inherits whatever the host has.
mechanisms.probe_status: NOT PROBEABLE HERE: `kilo` is not installed (shutil.which -> None), so the default lane cannot start. Recorded as BLOCKED, not as a pass.
mechanisms.possible_closure: external network cut around the lane process (probe-proven mechanism, but see sharp edges), or a code change to the backend.

mechanisms.why: The codex backend passes explicit approval/sandbox flags: `-a never --sandbox workspace-write exec ...` for coding (codex_cli.py:313, full_auto=True) and `--sandbox read-only` for planning (codex_cli.py:294). It never passes `--search`, so web search is left at the CLI default.

executed_probe.end_to_end: on the real model lane, a codex turn with the shell tool at `-s workspace-write` produced canary egress=BLOCKED (evidence/08_e2e_codex_workspace_write.jsonl)
executed_probe.note: the same CLI sandbox the backend selects; run through a0/closure/probes/cli_sandbox_probe.sh

mechanisms.cost_of_the_change: Switching the backend changes M (model/provider route), P (prompt/tool surface) and T for the run -- A0.1/A0.2 must be re-run for the backend actually used, and A1 must not silently mix backends.

mechanisms.why: cursor_cli.py:40-62 builds `<cursor-agent> -p PROMPT --model ... --force`; `--force` skips confirmations and no sandbox/network switch is passed. Same class of problem as the kilocode default.

sharp_edges: The lane's environment is inherited from the host (kilocode_cli.py:544-565 (env = os.environ.copy() at :546) copies os.environ, then applies extra_env and per-job HOME/XDG/TMPDIR redirection when state_root is set), so an agent can also reach any service the host environment exposes -- closure is not just about the CLI flags.

An external network cut severs host-local services; Loreley additionally needs Postgres and Redis. Under docker --internal those must be SIBLINGS on the same internal network (probe-proven 'sibling reachable, egress blocked'), not published host ports; and the model endpoint must live inside the barrier too.

Loreley's evaluator may be reworked by a rework agent (worker_evaluator_rework_enabled=True by default, config.py Settings output in evidence/04_seam_loreley.log) -- a second agent lane inside the same boundary that A0.1 must account for.
unverified: Any dynamic loreley behaviour: default backend missing (kilo not installed), Postgres/Redis not started by this workstream, and no campaign was run.

Whether the codex backend's default `web_search` state keeps the provider-side search tool off. Note the provider caveat carried over from the EvE/KAPSO probes: on this machine's custom provider a real model turn reported no web-search tool even with web search enabled (evidence/10b_e2e_websearch_live.jsonl), so this front door is provider-dependent.
